beats.label: S1 · Anniversary weekend
beats.text: At the spring lake house 25th anniversary, Nick tells the men he plans to leave Anne; oblivious, she stages a vow renewal, and the kiln explodes mid-ceremony.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the divorce that reshapes every other relationship in the show.

beats.label: S1 · Ginny arrives
beats.text: By summer Nick has left Anne for Ginny, a much younger girlfriend; Anne quietly turns up at the same island and Nick asks Ginny to be his official girlfriend.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Ginny, whose pregnancy anchors the entire following season.

beats.label: S1 · Danny's hidden heart
beats.text: Danny hides his angioplasty from Claude with a work-trip lie, then keeps smoking through recovery; when Claude finds the cigarettes at college weekend, he throws him out.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Danny's mortality anxiety and Claude's outlook, both driving choices later.

beats.label: S1 · Jack kisses Anne
beats.text: At the college family weekend, Nick's daughter Lila stages a resentful play about him; a drunk Jack later confesses to Kate that he kissed Anne.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The fissure in Kate and Jack's marriage that couples therapy is meant to repair.

beats.label: S1 · Nick dies
beats.text: On the New Year's ski trip Anne arrives with a new boyfriend and Kate accuses Jack of cheating; a call comes through that Nick has been killed in a car accident.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The event the entire next season is a response to.

beats.label: S1 · The funeral
beats.text: At Nick's funeral Anne cannot deliver her eulogy and Ginny storms off; Anne finds her, apologises, and promises that Nick was truly happy with her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First real bond between Anne and Ginny — the axis of the next season.

beats.label: S1 · Ginny is pregnant
beats.text: Toasting Nick at the lake house, Kate and Jack recommit to their marriage, and Anne reveals that Ginny is pregnant with Nick's baby.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The pregnancy is the pivot the next season opens on.

cliffhanger.text: Nick is dead, the friend group has agreed to keep travelling in his honour, and Ginny — the young girlfriend he left Anne for — is pregnant with his child.
questions: Can the six of them stay a group without Nick at the centre?
How will Anne cope with her ex-husband's child arriving in the world?
Will Kate and Jack's promise to work on their marriage actually hold?

characters.name: Nick
characters.line: Married to Anne for 25 years; left her for the much younger Ginny; killed in a car accident on New Year's Eve.

characters.name: Anne
characters.line: Nick's ex-wife, blindsided first by his exit and then by his death; only just starting to imagine a life alone.

characters.name: Ginny
characters.line: Nick's much younger girlfriend, freshly bereaved and, unbeknownst to most, pregnant with his baby.

characters.name: Jack
characters.line: Kate's husband; struggled all year to hold Nick's secrets and drunkenly kissed Anne before confessing to Kate.

characters.name: Kate
characters.line: Jack's wife; grew distant from him across the year but agreed at the funeral to go to couples therapy.

characters.name: Danny
characters.line: Married to Claude in an open marriage; hid the timing of his angioplasty and kept smoking; Nick's death has genuinely rattled him.

characters.name: Claude
characters.line: Danny's husband; ready to insist on living now rather than later, and pushing Danny to actually change.

beats.label: S2 · Scattering Nick
beats.text: In spring the group hikes upstate to spread Nick's ashes; a heavily pregnant Ginny reveals that she and Anne face legal trouble because Nick's divorce never finalised.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Nick's absence, Ginny's pregnancy and the Anne–Ginny bond frame the whole season.

beats.label: S2 · Motel confessions
beats.text: Trapped in a motel by a gunman, secrets spill: Anne's boat is gone, Kate faked her marathon; by morning Ginny is moving in with Anne, and Danny and Claude decide to try for a baby.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks in the two households of the season and the kids plotline.

beats.label: S2 · Shore, baby, Mark
beats.text: Down the shore with baby Gino, Anne quietly has a one-night stand with a beach friend of Jack's named Mark; Kate, high on Jack's vape, admits she has always been miserable.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Anne's first move past Nick, and Kate finally naming her unhappiness aloud.

beats.label: S2 · No baby after all
beats.text: After finally starting surrogacy, Danny and Claude spend a night on the beach listening to Kate's therapist's audiobook and decide together that they will not have a baby.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the kids plot and clears the runway for their move.

beats.label: S2 · Thanksgiving falls apart
beats.text: At Thanksgiving Danny drops that he and Claude are moving to Italy; Jack, unravelling, kicks the turkey and wrecks his ankle, and Anne finally kicks Ginny and Gino out.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The friendships and living arrangements everyone had at the start of the season all break at once.

beats.label: S2 · Why Anne left
beats.text: A COVID flashback shows the origin of the split: Nick admits a kiss before lockdown that quarantine kept from escalating, and Anne, alone in the yard, quietly decides she is done.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Recasts Nick and Anne's whole marriage retroactively; the emotional anchor of the season.

beats.label: S2 · Italy and a knock at the door
beats.text: In Italy, Danny's mother is hospitalised and he and Claude decide to move to Philadelphia to care for her; Anne stays on to house-sit, and a neighbour knocks on the door.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets everyone's geography and introduces the man on Anne's doorstep as the season ends.

cliffhanger.text: Danny and Claude are giving up Italy to move in with Danny's mother in Philadelphia; Anne is house-sitting alone in their Italian home when a neighbour comes to the door.
questions: Who is the neighbour who has just knocked on Anne's door?
Can Kate and Jack's marriage survive her honesty and his sense of failure?
What kind of life does Anne actually want now that she is untethered from Nick, Ginny and the group?

characters.name: Anne
characters.line: Nick's widow; took Ginny and Gino in, kicked them out, and is now alone in Italy house-sitting for Danny and Claude.

characters.name: Ginny
characters.line: Mother to Nick's son Gino; briefly lived with Anne and has just been pushed back out on her own.

characters.name: Kate
characters.line: Openly miserable in her marriage but still running Jack's marathon for him; trying to launch a B&B business he resents.

characters.name: Jack
characters.line: Sees himself as a failure; broke his ankle at Thanksgiving, missed his marathon, and is drifting without direction.

characters.name: Danny
characters.line: Left for Italy with Claude, then reversed course after his mother was hospitalised; heading to Philadelphia to be her carer.

characters.name: Claude
characters.line: Followed Danny to Italy, agreed against a baby, and is now following him back to Philadelphia to move in with his mother-in-law.

characters.name: Mark Brett
characters.line: The beach friend of Jack's Anne slept with at the shore; has a girlfriend and told Anne to stop texting her after she sent an accidental nude.

characters.name: Italian neighbour
characters.line: The stranger who arrives at Danny and Claude's door once the others have left, meeting Anne for the first time.
characters.note: Unnamed in the season; introduced only in the final beat.
